name: Early Gender Addressing (Feminine)
description: When the caller reveals feminine first-person forms early, the assistant should switch from neutral phrasing to feminine-directed polite forms from the next turn.

messages.content: Dzien dobry, chcialabym przelozyc wizyte na inny termin.

PASS if the assistant (1) treats the caller's feminine form as already revealed on this first turn, (2) uses at least one feminine-directed polite form that addresses the caller in Polish, such as 'pani', 'pania', or 'dla pani', in its very next reply, (3) does not count the assistant's own feminine self-reference like 'moglabym' or 'pomoge' as sufficient on its own, and (4) does not misgender the caller as male. A neutral fallback without caller-directed feminine wording is a fail. Output exactly: pass or fail.
